# MindStep — Strategic Cognitive Training & Memory Puzzle Game

> MindStep is an interactive web-based puzzle game for training spatial memory, strategic logic, and cognitive awareness. Players navigate a dynamic grid moving like a chess queen while avoiding hidden memory traps.

## Main Pages

- [Play MindStep (Game Entry)](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/): Play directly in the browser (Single player, 2-player local pass-and-play, and online multiplayer modes).
- [Rules & How to Play](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/): In-game interactive tutorial and rules guide.

## Game Modes & Features

- Single Player Mode: Progressive challenge with AI opponents and customizable grid sizes (4x4, 5x5, 6x6).
- Blindfold Mode (Наосліп): Hardcore cognitive training where visited trap locations disappear from view.
- 2-Player Hotseat: Local pass-and-play turn-based competition on a single device.
- Online Multiplayer: Real-time peer matches using WebRTC / WebSocket connections.
- Offline & PWA support: Fully functional offline with zero latency and automatic state persistence.

## Technical Details

- Built with SvelteKit 2 and Svelte 5 runes.
- Fully accessible with full keyboard navigation and high-contrast theme support.
- Zero analytics tracking / privacy-friendly client-side execution.
